focus: Internal Question Worthiness Criteria via Expected Information Gain
question: Does adding a contextual relevance feature to the logistic‑regression predictor increase its AUC‑ROC by at least 0.03 (3 percentage points) while keeping average inference latency no more than 5 % higher than the baseline model?
